company.introduction: SEGRO owns, manages and develops warehouses and industrial property in the UK and continental Europe. Its assets include urban space near major population centres and larger distribution facilities located around transport networks. Customers use these buildings for logistics, storage, production and other operating needs. Revenue comes from rent, while development and asset management can increase future income and property value. Occupancy, lease terms and rental growth are important to results. The business requires investment in buildings and land, with financing costs and property yields affecting valuations. Location and the availability of suitable space influence its ability to attract and retain occupiers.

overallConfidence.methodology: Overall confidence combines press sentiment (40%), annual-report tone (35%) and emerging themes (25%). Missing signals are excluded and lower-quality evidence pulls the result towards neutral rather than creating a positive score. Where lexical tone is unavailable, annual-report direction is represented once through emerging themes to prevent double counting.
